statements.markdown: **Theorem 6.21 (Eventually-periodic support irrationality).** *Let $b\ge2$ and $m\ge1$ be integers. An infinite support whose membership is $m$-periodic from some threshold $N_0$ onward has irrational $X_A(b)$.*
